fact: The National Statistics Council (CNEST) held a two-day international conference in Praia on 24-25 April 2025 on the challenges and opportunities for Cabo Verde's first national data strategy, which its president said was to hold entities accountable for providing timely data; the government was represented at the opening by a Secretary of State, and no adoption is stated.

TechAfrica News (published 2026-05-04) reports that Cape Verde launched the development of a Data Strategy for Public Administration at a kick-off meeting of senior officials, the Secretary of State for the Digital Economy, external consultants and EU representatives, held 28 April 2026 per the note; no adoption is stated.
